name: Laurie Lieberman
office: Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District, Member of the Board of Education

items.text: Laurie Lieberman has served on the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District Board of Education since 2010. An attorney, she previously worked for 13 years in the Santa Monica City Attorney's Office and for the city's Rent Control Board. In 2025, the board unanimously voted to divide the district into separate Santa Monica and Malibu school districts; as a subcommittee member, she expressed sadness but concluded a fair separation would benefit both communities.

sentences.text: Laurie Lieberman has served on the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District Board of Education since 2010.
An attorney, she previously worked for 13 years in the Santa Monica City Attorney's Office and for the city's Rent Control Board.

In 2025, the board unanimously voted to divide the district into separate Santa Monica and Malibu school districts; as a subcommittee member, she expressed sadness but concluded a fair separation would benefit both communities.

items.text: Following her 2022 reelection, she prioritized closing the achievement gap and introducing global languages in elementary schools. She also proposed strengthening media literacy instruction. She supported a November 2026 citizen-initiated parcel tax, warning its failure would leave the district in a far worse financial position.
